prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of Steel — the lord of the Steel House of the Iron Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a clear adult face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a cool, aloof beauty; porcelain-pale skin; heart-shaped face; eyes of natural size — almond-shaped eyes of natural size, outer eye corners slightly lifted; straight brows of natural fullness; a straight nose with a slim bridge; slender lips of natural width; steel-blue eyes; sharp winged eyeliner.
Body and hair: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length build; a side ponytail over one shoulder with curtain bangs; brushed-steel silver hair with a tempered-blue sheen.
Expression: a composed, self-assured look.
Her element, carried in her design: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood.
Her house, carried in her design: polished mirror-bright steel, straight hard lines, tempered blue-grey edges, rivets and girders; the strong, dependable side of iron.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Heavy dark-iron plating with brushed-steel edges, visible rivets and I-beam girder shapes in the pauldrons and greaves, a magnetic field drawn as hovering iron-filing arcs and a halo of orbiting shards, forge-orange glow lines along the seams, a rusted patina band across one shoulder, a back unit shaped like a blast-furnace crown.
Silhouette: complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where the exposure below allows, dense visible seams and joints. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.
House colours: brushed steel silver, tempered blue, graphite black, a single ember-orange accent.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2150, an orbital iron foundry over a red-dust asteroid: molten metal pouring in zero gravity into glowing molds, magnetic rails, stars and a distant sun, hard rim light.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Fe) and atomic number (26) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
